tabs.title: Search engines
tabs.description: Whole kinds of page that should stay out of search results, so they do not have to be hidden one at a time. A page hidden here is still reachable by anyone with the link — this only asks search engines to leave it out.

fields.title: Hide these post types
fields.help_text: Every post of the ticked types is hidden, unless a post says otherwise in its own SEO box.

fields.title: Hide these archives
fields.help_text: The listing pages for a taxonomy — a category or tag archive — rather than the posts in them. Worth hiding when the listings mostly repeat what the posts already say.

fields.title: Hide author archives
fields.help_text: The pages listing everything one person wrote. On a site with a single author they repeat the front page, and a search engine has to decide which of the two is the real one.

fields.title: Hide date archives
fields.help_text: The pages listing everything published in a month or a year. They rarely answer a question anybody typed.
